title: Preserve beat barre fret and shape
scope: Retain GPIF BarreFret and BarreString/shape properties independently from chord diagram barres.
acceptance: Use distinct barre frets and full/half shapes at two beat locations.
A beat-level barre can coexist with a chord diagram containing different barre data.
Check fret and enum boundaries and independently assert edited GP8 output.
exclusions: GP3 through GP5 do not expose GPIF beat-level barre properties.
Chord diagram barre ranges are independent and remain owned by ticket #79.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Audits paired payloads, exact shape values, and checked fret boundaries.
Imports checked beat-level fret and shape values without narrowing wrap.
Writes exact paired BarreFret/Fret and BarreString/String properties.
Covers actual GP7 import, distinct full/half marks, chord independence, validation, exact GP8 wire, strict policy, and int16 boundaries.
Uses pinned AlphaTab facts for source, Go output, and a post-parse edit.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[0].voices[0].beats[0].barreFret. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

resolution: Added paired Beat.BarreFret and Beat.BarreShape authorities, checked GPIF import diagnostics, exact GP8 property output, public validation, and independent pinned-consumer evidence. The refreshed probe now preserves all 22 non-default barre facts in testdata/gp7/barre.gp and all 6 in testdata/gp7/beat-barre.gp. Chord diagram barre ranges remain separate and explicitly outside this ticket.
